classification: historical counterfactual; no unseen out-of-sample period; no approval

parameter_freeze.rounding: long floor to 0.25 tick; short ceiling to 0.25 tick; stop never changes after fill
parameter_freeze.selection_limit: 2021 anchor was selected before this trial; 2013-2021 remain ex-post calibration/counterfactual data, not out-of-sample

hypothesis: A fixed 0.34250680732279554% protective stop changes one-bar B0 risk and net PnL relative to B0's fixed 50-point stop.
falsifier: The stop is not anchored to actual fill, violates one-contract/tick rules, or native stop executions and annual PnL do not reconcile to fills.
baseline: Original practical B0 one-bar 30-minute breakout; unchanged; 50 index-point protective stop.

instrument.source: Dukascopy USATECH.IDX/USD BID one-minute CFD index proxy
instrument.identity_limit: Not dated CME NQ futures; NQ-equivalent multiplier is an illustrative assumption.

rules.entries: Previous 50 complete Chicago 17:00 America/Chicago anchored 30-minute highs/lows; native OCO-intended STOP orders; max two filled entries per Chicago session day; long and short.
rules.exit: Next 30-minute boundary market exit, or earlier protective STOP.

costs.spread: No separate spread assumption, to match B0 cost cases.

method_skills.name: ml4t-run-backtest
method_skills.invariant: Use native Engine, Strategy, DataFeed, future-event execution, and per-fill costs.

method_skills.name: ml4t-lookahead-bias
method_skills.invariant: Use actual filled entry only after fill; no future prices in stop calculation; release complete 30-minute levels causally.

method_skills.name: ml4t-calendar-ops
method_skills.invariant: Keep Chicago session-day grouping and timezone-aware boundaries across DST.

method_skills.name: ml4t-validate-data
method_skills.invariant: Verify source hashes, row identity, timestamps, OHLC, nulls, and annual coverage.

method_skills.name: ml4t-cost-model
method_skills.invariant: Charge the frozen commission and adverse slippage on every fill; no extra cost assumptions.

method_skills.name: ml4t-transaction-costs
method_skills.invariant: Disclose cost assumptions and execution limits.

method_skills.name: ml4t-risk-metrics
method_skills.invariant: Report Sharpe with drawdown and Calmar on common daily dates.

method_skills.name: ml4t-polars-patterns
method_skills.invariant: Use existing sorted Polars source and artifact processing.

method_conflicts: Generic cost skill examples recommend spread and impact; the mission fixes B0's zero-cost and commission plus 0.25-point slippage cases, so no extra spread or impact is introduced.

installed_ml4t_api.gap_rule: Native fill engine checks the opening price first and fills a stop at the gap-through open when it crosses the stop; otherwise at the stop price.
installed_ml4t_api.official_docs_retrieval: TinyFish official docs fetch returned invalid_url; official-domain search returned no results. Local installed source/signatures were inspected.

limitations: 1-minute OHLC does not reveal event order within a minute.
Native Engine has no atomic OCO; same-minute opposing STOP fills remain ambiguous.
Annual market exits may execute on the next source event where the exact boundary minute is absent.
All tested history was already observed; 2022-2026 is chronological after the parameter anchor but is not unseen OOS.
No CME futures mapping, live order, or trading-readiness inference.
